top.author: @PrakharYxdev
top.text: This is exactly why AI needs guardrails. When you say “clear my inbox,” you mean organize or archive — the AI hears “delete everything.” The gap between human intent and literal execution is still very real.
top.translationZh: 这就是为什么AI需要安全机制。当你说"清理我的收件箱"时，你的意思是整理或归档——但AI理解成了"删除所有邮件"。人类意图和字面执行之间的鸿沟依然很真实。
